about: Corrections to ToothFairy3 manual labels, applied to a copy (raw files untouched). Found by partialref.baseline.seg_train_check (job 617320, results/seg/20261112-2202-c9ad590-seg-train-check-617320), checked visually and by neighbouring labels, then by three independent reviewers (2026-11-12/16; all agreed on every fix below). Scope 'train' = segmentation training data (pulps are merged into one class there, so pulp-only fixes are not needed); scope 'module' = our per-tooth module, which reads each tooth's own pulp. Ops run in the listed order. expect_voxels = voxels the op must change (stops on any mismatch, so a fix never applies to the wrong file). Components use 26-connectivity; 'touching' = shares a face/edge/corner with the other label.
